qualification.lexicalIndexRows: Chinese/pinyin/lessonNo only; no per-word Vietnamese gloss fabricated. This61scope does not newly certify every Chinese/PY lexical index row.
qualification.excludedBoundaryClassification: 160–162 colophon/activation/backcover classified by author; not independently visually accepted here; no numeric footer presumed and no activation code transcribed/reproduced by reviewer.
qualification.originalScannedGlyphs: * and ★ are explicit manual visual proxies, not decoded PDF Unicode.
qualification.durability: Need author V1 + author V2 + this own original fresh evidence all raw-byte/SHA/Gitblob remote readback receipt before saved-source-accepted count; shared appendix not an additional course.
